name: Sheglam Jelly Wow Hydrating Lip Oil Moisturizing Plumping Lip Gloss 5pcs Set
description:
Sheglam Jelly Wow Hydrating Lip Oil – 5pcs Set
Weight: 6g x 5
Shades Included: Berry Involved, Grapefruit Glow, Green Apple Envy, Loco For Coco, Mali-Blue Berry

Give your lips the ultimate hydration and shine with the Sheglam Jelly Wow Hydrating Lip Oil. This 5-piece set delivers a luscious, plumping gloss in vibrant, fun shades.

High-Shine Finish: Apply over bare lips or lipstick for a glossy, radiant look.

Non-Sticky Formula: Innovative oil formula provides shine without the tacky feel.

Moisturizing & Hydrating: Keeps lips soft, smooth, and nourished all day.

Skin-Loving Ingredients: Enriched with Vitamin C, grapefruit extract, hyaluronic acid, and squalane for healthy, happy lips.

Cruelty-Free: Leaping Bunny certified, 100% cruelty-free beauty.

Perfect for everyday wear or a glamorous night out, this lip oil set ensures your lips stay glossy, hydrated, and irresistible.
